cleanPlate.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: clean background plate for a layered pixel-art website scene.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing navy nighttime castle, island, lake and foreground promenade. Preserve its exact 1536x1024 composition and 3:2 aspect ratio.
Primary request: remove ONLY the complete castle architecture, including every tower/spire, roof, building, wall, stair, arch bridge/aqueduct, doorway, window, lamp mounted to architecture, and small waterside chapel. Do not put any new buildings or towers in their places.
Preserve invariants aggressively: keep all existing night sky, stars, distant mountains, clouds, forests, all rocky island cliffs and their silhouettes, lake surface, golden light reflections in the lake, foreground trees, and foreground stone promenade and railing in EXACTLY the same positions, sizes, shapes, perspective, sharp detailed pixel-art style, and palette. The bottom lake and promenade especially must match the source image.
Fill only the holes left by removed architecture with the natural dark navy sky, distant forest/mountain layer or island rock/vegetation that would be behind that architecture. The removed large castle should reveal dark open sky above the original rugged forested rocky island, not a replacement landmass filling its silhouette. Keep the island cliffs below the original castle unchanged as much as possible. Keep the original water reflections even though the light sources are removed: this image will be recomposited with original castle objects later.
Style: tasteful detailed 16/32-bit navy blue pixel art, crisp square pixel detail, no soft blur, no photorealistic painting, no new objects, no text, no border.
Constraints: exact viewpoint and composition of the source, no crop, no camera change, no scale change.

spriteAtlas.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production game CHARACTER SPRITE ATLAS on true transparent alpha, for a detailed navy-blue pixel-art Hogwarts nighttime website scene.
Primary request: create exactly FOUR HORIZONTAL ROWS and THREE evenly spaced COLUMNS of independent complete sprites on a 1536 x 1536 square transparent canvas. Cells are conceptually 512x384. Do NOT draw the grid. Keep generous totally transparent gutters of at least 55 pixels around every character; isolated silhouettes must never touch one another. No text or labels anywhere.
ROW 1 (top row, centered within each cell): cell1 Harry Potter flying on a full broom RIGHT, strict readable side view; black tousled hair, very clearly visible round black glasses, youthful face, black school cloak, red-and-gold scarf trailing LEFT, legs sitting astride broom, full broom bristles at LEFT and long stick pointing RIGHT. Width about 375px and height about 245px. Cell2 same Harry identity, proportions, side-view and broom position, only alternate fluttering scarf/cape animation pose; broom and rider fully present. Cell3 a small separate golden snitch, a gold ball with delicate outstretched pale-golden feathered wings, about 130px total width. No Harry in third cell.
ROW 2: three full-body Albus Dumbledore sprites, each facing RIGHT, height about 275px. Recognizable elderly wizard with long silver beard, long silver hair, half-moon spectacles, tall soft purple/navy cap, rich purple/navy robes with silver trim. Cell1 walking pose A with right foot leading; cell2 walking pose B with other foot leading, same head/proportions; cell3 feet planted and right arm raising wooden wand diagonally up to the right, casting pose. Entire wand fits inside its own cell.
ROW 3: three full-body Lord Voldemort sprites, each facing RIGHT, height about 275px. Pale bald noseless narrow face, long flowing near-black/navy robe, slender frightening but game-friendly silhouette. Cell1 walking pose A, cell2 walking pose B, cell3 feet planted with arm and wooden wand raised diagonally to the right. Identical identity and scale through row. Entire wand fits inside its own cell.
ROW 4: two complete Dementor sprites centered in first and second cells, each hovering toward RIGHT, height about 280px. Tattered near-black/navy hooded cloaks, empty deeply dark hood cavity, thin claw-like hands and wispy tapering torn cloak tails. Cell1 hovering pose A with trailing cloth to left; cell2 alternate floating cloth pose B. Third cell completely empty and transparent.
Style/medium: CRISP 16/32-bit VIDEO GAME PIXEL ART sprites, visible square pixel clusters and stepped contours, restrained shaded palette, clean navy-dark outlines, fine recognizable faces. Match detailed tasteful blue-pixel-art Hogwarts scenery and a warm cartoon cat, with slightly cartoon proportions that read clearly when humans are rendered 85-110 CSS pixels tall and Harry 140 CSS pixels wide. Characters must read as small side-view game sprites, not painted portrait illustrations. Use light gray-blue edge highlights so dark robes remain legible over a deep navy scene.
Constraints: Every character fully contained inside its separate cell, entire body and all accessories, no clipping, no touching cells. All character sprites face RIGHT. No spell beams, no spell effects, no glow halos, no floor shadows, no platforms, no environmental objects, no background color, no checkerboard, no labels, no UI. True transparent alpha background including all gutters and around isolated sprites.
